purpose: Keep disabled translation mounts, exact distance joints, distance limits, world-axis translation locks, world-axis translation limits and fixed-direction locks in validated evidence while excluding them from solver residuals and collision-isolation topology before one-step delegation.

properties.constraints: any supported six-family translation constraint set with optional enabled=false
properties.options: optional isolateCollisions boolean plus nested composer/isolation options

limitations: direct lower-level composer/isolation entrypoints retain their own compatibility semantics
disabled definitions are still normalized and therefore must reference valid bodies
axis-lock, axis-limit and fixed-direction-lock filtering does not imply rotating axes, angular limits or motor semantics
fixed-direction locks remain fixed in world space and leave perpendicular translation free
collision isolation remains component-wide across enabled edges when requested

proves: disabled legacy-family constraints remain physically and topologically inert through the guarded route
disabled axis locks are retained in evidence but excluded from solving and isolation topology
disabled axis limits are retained in evidence but excluded from solving and isolation topology
disabled fixed-direction locks are retained in evidence but excluded from solving and isolation topology while enabled locks still delegate through one donor-core step

truth.basis: The gate distinguishes validated retained definitions from the active subset actually delegated across all six families.

agency.basis: Caller enabled=false choices are honored as inert across all six supported families.

continuity.basis: The guarded route grows with the composer while preserving donor source and prior family behavior.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Filtering remains explicit and bounded instead of hiding disabled edges inside residual or topology calculations.
